valid_pair =: 4 : 0
 'causal unrelated' =. x
 'a b' =. y
 (*./,(<a;b){causal)*.(*./,(<a;a){unrelated)*.*./,(<b;b){unrelated
)
alpha_relation =: 4 : 0
 f =. follows y
 tri =. triangles y
 causal =. (f>0)*.0=|:f
 if. x do. causal =. (f>0)*.((0=|:f)+.(tri>0)*.(|:tri)>0) end.
 unrelated =. (f=0)*.(|:f)=0
 symbols =. causal+2*((-.causal)*.|:causal)
 parallel =. (f>0)*.(|:f)>0
 if. x do. parallel =. parallel*.-.(tri>0)*.(|:tri)>0 end.

discover =: 3 : 0
 'log tids plus' =. y
 f =. follows log
 tri =. triangles log
 causal =. (f>0)*.(0=|:f)
 if. plus do. causal =. (f>0)*.((0=|:f)+.(tri>0)*.(|:tri)>0) end.
 unrelated =. (f=0)*.(|:f)=0
 pairs =. 0$a:
 for_a. tids do. for_b. tids do.
  pair =. (,a);,b
  if. (causal;unrelated)valid_pair pair do. pairs =. pairs,<pair end.
 end. end.
 i =. 0
 while. i<#pairs do.
  'a b' =. i{::pairs
  for_t. tids do.
   for_side. i.2 do.
    aa =. a
    bb =. b
    if. side=0 do. aa =. /:~~.a,t else. bb =. /:~~.b,t end.
    pair =. aa;bb
    if. -.(<pair)e.pairs do. if. (causal;unrelated)valid_pair pair do. pairs =. pairs,<pair end. end.
   end.
  end.
  i =. i+1
 end.
 maximal =. 0$a:
 for_pair. pairs do.
  'a b' =. >pair
  max =. 1
  for_t. tids do.
   if. -.t e.a do. if. (causal;unrelated)valid_pair (/:~a,t);b do. max =. 0 end. end.
   if. -.t e.b do. if. (causal;unrelated)valid_pair a;/:~b,t do. max =. 0 end. end.
  end.
  if. max do. maximal =. maximal,pair end.
 end.
 maximal =. /:~maximal
 starts =. ends =. i.0
 for_item. log do. trace =. 0{::>item
 starts =. starts,{.trace
 ends =. ends,{:trace end.
 starts =. /:~~.starts
 ends =. /:~~.ends
 places =. <'start'
 for_i. 1+i.#maximal do. places =. places,<'p',str i end.
 places =. places,<'end'
 ins =. outs =. (#tids)$<i.0
 for_j. i.#tids do.
  t =. j{tids
  input =. output =. i.0
  if. t e.starts do. input =. ,0 end.
  if. t e.ends do. output =. ,1+#maximal end.
  for_i. i.#maximal do.
   'a b' =. i{::maximal
   if. t e.a do. output =. output,i+1 end.
   if. t e.b do. input =. input,i+1 end.
  end.
  ins =. (< /:~input)j}ins
  outs =. (< /:~output)j}outs
 end.
 net =. places;tids;ins;outs;0;(1+#maximal)
 net;maximal;(#pairs);(+/,(<tids;tids){causal);(plus alpha_relation log);tri
)

 for_t. trans do.

  input =. output =. i.0

 'missing remaining consumed produced' =. y
 1-((x:missing)%2*consumed)-((x:remaining)%2*produced)

reachability =: 3 : 0
 'places tids ins outs initial final' =. y
 marking =. (#places)$0
 marking =. 1 initial}marking
 target =. 1 final}(#places)$0
 markings =. ,:marking
 edges =. 0 3$0
 unsafe =. deadlocks =. 0
 live =. (#tids)$0
 df =. (NA,NA)$0
 head =. 0
 while. head<#markings do.
  marking =. head{markings
  active =. y enabled marking
  live =. 1 active}live
  if. (0=#active)*.-.marking-:target do. deadlocks =. deadlocks+1 end.
  for_t. active do.
   next =. fire y;marking;t
   if. +./next>1 do. unsafe =. unsafe+1
   continue. end.
   hits =. I.next-:"1 markings
   if. #hits do. j =. {.hits else. j =. #markings
   markings =. markings,next end.
   edges =. edges,head,t,j
   for_u. y enabled next do. df =. 1(<(t{tids),u{tids)}df end.
  end.
  head =. head+1
 end.
 reached =. I.target-:"1 markings
 good =. reached
 while. 1 do.
  before =. #good
  good =. ~.good,0{"1 edges#~(2{"1 edges)e.good
  if. before=#good do. break. end.
 end.
 dead =. (-.live)#tids
 stuck =. (#markings)-#good
 sound =. (unsafe=0)*.(stuck=0)*.0=#dead
 (#markings);(#edges);unsafe;deadlocks;stuck;(0<#reached);dead;sound;df
)
replay =: 3 : 0
 'places tids ins outs initial final' =. y
 np =. #places
 rows =. 0 5$0
 fit =. i.0x
 totalsmissing =. totalsremaining =. deviating =. np$0
 waits =. np$<i.0
 routes =. (np,#tids)$0
 for_ids. Cases do.
  ids =. >ids
  tokens =. np$<i.0
  tokens =. (<,(<({.ids),2){Events)initial}tokens
  missing =. np$0
  consumed =. 0
  produced =. 1
  skipped =. 0
  for_ei. ids do.
   'cid act time res line' =. ei{Events
   t =. tids i.act
   if. t=#tids do. skipped =. skipped+1
   continue. end.
   for_p. t{::ins do.
    consumed =. consumed+1
    held =. p{::tokens
    if. #held do.
     tokens =. (<}.held)p}tokens
     waits =. (<(p{::waits),time-{.held)p}waits
     routes =. (1+(<p,t){routes)(<p,t)}routes
    else. missing =. (1+p{missing)p}missing end.
   end.
   for_p. t{::outs do. tokens =. (<(p{::tokens),time)p}tokens
   produced =. produced+1 end.
  end.
  consumed =. consumed+1
  held =. final{::tokens
  if. #held do. tokens =. (<}.held)final}tokens
  else. missing =. (1+final{missing)final}missing end.
  remaining =. #&>tokens
  m =. +/missing
  r =. +/remaining
  rows =. rows,skipped,m,r,consumed,produced
  fit =. fit,fitness m,r,consumed,produced
  totalsmissing =. totalsmissing+missing
  totalsremaining =. totalsremaining+remaining
  deviating =. deviating+(missing>0)+.remaining>0
 end.
 rows;fit;totalsmissing;totalsremaining;deviating;waits;routes
)
precision =: 3 : 0
 'places tids ins outs initial final' =. y
 prefixes =. 0$a:
 for_trace. Traces do.
  trace =. >trace
  for_n. i.1+#trace do. prefixes =. prefixes,<n{.trace end.
 end.
 prefixes =. ~.prefixes
 allowed =. escaping =. fitted =. 0
 escapeweights =. (#tids)$0
 for_prefix. prefixes do.
  prefix =. >prefix
  weight =. 0
  followers =. i.0
  for_trace. Traces do.
   trace =. >trace
   if. prefix-:(#prefix){.trace do.
    weight =. weight+1
    if. (#trace)>#prefix do. followers =. followers,(#prefix){trace end.
   end.
  end.
  marking =. 1 initial}(#places)$0
  ok =. 1
  for_act. prefix do.
   t =. tids i.act
   if. (t=#tids)+.-.t e.y enabled marking do. ok =. 0
   break. end.
   marking =. fire y;marking;t
  end.
  if. -.ok do. continue. end.
  fitted =. fitted+1
  active =. y enabled marking
  escapes =. active#~-. (active{tids)e.followers
  allowed =. allowed+weight*#active
  escaping =. escaping+weight*#escapes
  escapeweights =. ((escapes{escapeweights)+weight)escapes}escapeweights
 end.
 value =. 1x
 if. allowed do. value =. 1-(x:escaping)%allowed end.
 fitted;allowed;escaping;value;escapeweights
)

heuristic_report =: 3 : 0
 f =. Follows
 tri =. triangles FullLog
 sigma =. pn 'positive_observations'
 l1 =. NA$0
 l2 =. (NA,NA)$0
 graph =. (NA,NA)$0
 out =. 0$a:
 for_a. ActivityIds do.
  n =. (<a,a){f
  if. n do.
   measure =. loop_measure n
   accepted =. (n>:sigma)*.measure>:pn 'loop1_threshold'
   l1 =. accepted a}l1
   graph =. accepted(<a,a)}graph
   out =. out,<emit 'L1';(a{::AllNames);'count';n;'measure';(frac measure);accepted{::'REJECT';'ACCEPT'
  end.
 end.
 for_a. ActivityIds do. for_b. ActivityIds#~ActivityIds>a do.
  if. (a{l1)+.b{l1 do. continue. end.
  n =. ((<a,b){tri)+(<b,a){tri
  if. n do.
   measure =. loop_measure n
   accepted =. (n>:sigma)*.measure>:pn 'loop2_threshold'
   l2 =. accepted(<a,b)}l2
   l2 =. accepted(<b,a)}l2
   out =. out,<emit 'L2';(a{::AllNames);(b{::AllNames);'count';n;'measure';(frac measure);accepted{::'REJECT';'ACCEPT'
  end.
 end. end.
 for_a. ActivityIds do. for_b. ActivityIds-.a do.
  n =. (<a,b){f
  if. n=0 do. continue. end.
  d =. f dependency a,b
  bout =. bin =. _
  for_c. ActivityIds-.a do. if. (<a,c){f do. bout =. bout>.f dependency a,c end. end.
  for_c. ActivityIds-.b do. if. (<c,b){f do. bin =. bin>.f dependency c,b end. end.
  if. (<a,b){l2 do. verdict =. 'LOOP2'
  elseif. n<sigma do. verdict =. 'REJECT_COUNT'
  elseif. d<pn 'dependency_threshold' do. verdict =. 'REJECT_MEASURE'
  elseif. ((bout-d)>pn 'relative_to_best')*.((bin-d)>pn 'relative_to_best') do. verdict =. 'REJECT_BEST'
  else. verdict =. 'ACCEPT' end.
  if. (<verdict)e.'LOOP2';'ACCEPT' do. graph =. 1(<a,b)}graph end.
  out =. out,<emit 'DEP';(a{::AllNames);(b{::AllNames);'count';n;'reverse';((<b,a){f);'measure';(frac d);verdict
 end. end.
 for_a. ActivityIds do. out =. out,<emit 'NODE';(a{::AllNames);'in';(activity_list I.a{"1 graph);'out';activity_list I.a{graph end.
 for_a. ActivityIds do.
  for_join. i.2 do.
   if. join do. ns =. (I.a{"1 graph)-.a else. ns =. (I.a{graph)-.a end.
   for_b. ns do. for_c. ns#~ns>b do.
    measure =. branch_measure f;a;b;c;join
    out =. out,<emit (join{::'SPLIT';'JOIN');(a{::AllNames);(b{::AllNames);(c{::AllNames);'measure';(frac measure);(measure>:pn 'and_threshold'){::'XOR';'AND'
   end. end.
  end.
 end.
 out,<emit 'GRAPH activities';(#ActivityIds);'edges';(+/,graph);'loops1';(+/l1);'loops2';(+/,l2)%2
)

  for_row. (/:rows){rows do.

   elseif. kind=1 do. text =. emit name;(a{::Resources);(b{::Resources);'count';-negative
   else. text =. emit name;(a{::Resources);(b{::Resources);'cases';-negative end.
   out =. out,<text

  keepvariant =. keep i}keepvariant

 plusbase =. 0{::plusresult
 'places pts pins pouts initial final' =. plusbase

  t =. i{tids

  else.
   pre =. plustids#~0<(<plustids;t){wf

   for_k. i.#1{::plusresult do.
